scenarios.cost: Небольшой synthetic scope fixture + отдельный bounded cap witness; счёт реально прочитанных/отфильтрованных rows, не требование huge dataset.

scenarios.persistence: Schedule/recipe/profile binding сохраняется в calibration invocation/report; fresh consumer не переинтерпретирует scalar evidence как universal vectorized capability.
scenarios.oracle: Actual runtime emissions/forward counters after effects completion, analytic simple value/gradient/Hessian. Traced Python callcount не oracle laziness.
scenarios.transfer: Второе расписание/compatible emission contract через ресурсы, active/inactive transitions в другом timestep; no special known method names.
scenarios.cost: Bound steps/branches; measure no unwanted numerical work, not merely returned zeros. Full backend matrix не обязательна, заявленный supported device обязателен.

scenarios.cost: Bound attempts and successful rows separately; batch memory cap and no hidden newdraw retries. Exact summary arithmeticcost measured separately; no arbitrary-precision MC engine required.

Failed wholeblocks retained/dropped correctly, originaldenominator survives.600×100PCA randomized stage explicit local seed/global state invariant. Reversed costdirection/top-k/dedup cannot improve false score.
